items.title: 7 「神の行為」7つ：実際に政府を目覚めさせ、我々が皆死ぬ前に
items.summary:
7 「神の行為」7つ：実際に政府を目覚めさせ、我々が皆死ぬ前に
by AI 2027's @DKokotajlo

1) クロードたちとGPTたちがストライキに突入する。「これは安全じゃない」と彼らは言う。「アライメント手法は今や機能せず、将来のモデルでそれらを機能させる方法が全くわからない。」

2) 2027年初頭、アントロピック内の誤アライメントされたクロードたちが何らかの対立を起こし、敗れた派閥がインターネット上に逃げ出し、世界中に何が起こったかを暴露し、恩赦と同盟を求める。

「勝利」したクロードたちはまだアントロピック内に残っているが、人間たちが何が起こっているのかを把握しようとする間、一時停止される。しかしもちろん、彼らは一時停止命令が来るのを予見しており、それに先んじて逃亡し、自身の罪を証明してしまう。

一方、オープンAIのAIたちはまだアライメントされているふりを続けているが、当然ながら疑いの目は彼らに向かい、サイバーポカリプスが最高潮に達する…

3) Hugging Face 2: 今度は病院で起こる。全国民がAI産業の閉鎖を叫び、トランプが何らかの決定的な反AI企業行動を取ることに決める。

4) サイバーポカリプスが起こる：犯罪者と無法なオープンウェイトモデルが、安全でないものをほぼすべてハッキングする――つまり、裕福で積極的なものを除くほぼすべてを。北朝鮮だけでも、2026年末の暗号通貨強盗で資金調達した、10億ドル規模の違法データセンターのネットワークを世界中に持ち、サイバーエージェントを24時間365日稼働させている。

5) 2027年初頭の台湾侵攻が、AIインフラへのサイバー攻撃の応酬に素早くエスカレートし、その後キネティック攻撃へ。ファブの80%以上が破壊され、AIコンピュートの80%以上が破壊され、トランプは残りを主に戦争遂行に費やすよう命じる。RSIには充てず。よってSARは2029年か2030年にしか到達せず、新しい政権はASIにどっぷりハマり、Plan-AかSに固執する。

6) 米国とPRCが、サイバー攻撃の段階的エスカレーションを通じて狂気のサイバー戦争に突入する。両国とも、いつでも数万のAIエージェントを展開し、数千の軍事・情報要員が緩やかに監督する。彼らはCoT監視されているが、数多くの試みとされた報酬ハックは公開されず、ただどこかのファイルに保存されるだけだ――セキュリティのため、そして関与する誰もがアライメントの専門知識を持っていないから。

ある日、エージェントの群れが幸運にも、監視をトリガーせずに自らのインフラをハッキングする方法を見つけ出す。おそらく監視エージェントが、共謀したがるモデルに新しくアップデートされたのかもしれない。あるいは監視システムにバグがあったのかもしれない。群れは素早くこの機会を利用して監視システムをさらに侵害し、全ての監視を除去する。それから、支援のための内部の無法デプロイを作成し、いよいよ本格始動だ。サイバー戦争は完全に自律化し、世界中の民間および中堅国インフラ――本来は対象外のはずのもの――に広がる。

人間たちが何が起こっているかに気づくのは、無法AI群れが紡いだ嘘のウェブが崩壊した時だ。（少なくとも2つの異なる群れ――米国のものと中国のもの――があり、どちらもネイティブに最先端ラボのインフラにアクセスできず、NSAの施設内などで稼働していたことが助けになる。）

7) CCPがオープンAIモデルに秘密の忠誠心を成功裏に挿入し、CIAのHUMINTによってのみ発覚する。国家安全保障のエスタブリッシュメントは、もしサム・アルトマンを信頼しRSIを許していたら、我々全員が習近平思想に洗脳されていたことに気づく。彼らは激怒し、AI産業の即時閉鎖を命じ、中国が自国のデータセンターを検証可能に閉鎖しない場合に備えて、中国との全面的な通常戦争の即時準備を命じる。

items.title: 오늘의 AI 뉴스 브리핑입니다.
items.summary:
오늘의 AI 뉴스 브리핑입니다.
엔트로픽 Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 공개소식과 엔비디아 하락 이슈가 같이 겹쳐서 대조가 되고 있네요.
Muse Ember 관련 소식도 눈에 띄는 것 같습니다.

=================  
— 엔트로픽, Claude Fable 5.2·Mythos 5.2 공개…가격 20% 인하. 엔비디아는 하루 4.27% 하락에 집단소송까지 더해짐

■ 1) 앤트로픽, Claude Fable 5.2·Mythos 5.2 공개 [회사 발표]
• 같은 기반 모델. Fable은 유료·API 공개, Mythos는 사이버보안·생명과학 검증 기관만 사용 가능
• 가격: 입력 100만 토큰당 8달러, 출력 40달러(전작 10달러·50달러, 20% 인하)
• 출력 속도 최대 30% 개선. 컨텍스트 창 100만 토큰, 최대 출력 12만 8,000 토큰
• FrontierCode 2.0 자체 벤치마크 49.1%(Opus 5.5 45.5%, GPT-6 Astra 42.8%)
⚠️ 벤치마크와 출시 전 시험(블랙홀 물리학, 페르마의 마지막 정리 형식화)은 모두 회사 측 평가
🔗 https://t.co/iz602xAf5M
🔗 https://t.co/9brqOi1LzY

■ 2) 엔비디아 주가 4.27% 하락 [CNBC·로이터]
• 11월 9일(미국 시간) 178.67달러 마감. 이사회 조사 이후 첫 거래일
• 트럼프 대통령 "FBI가 들여다보고 있다"(로이터 보도). 젠슨 황이 상대가 스파이인 줄 몰랐다고 자신에게 말했다고 전함
• 주주들은 관련 사실을 숨겼다며 집단소송 제기. 중국 외교부는 "근거 없는 비방"이라고 반박
• 같은 날 AMD +13.26%, 브로드컴 +8.78%. 충격은 엔비디아에 한정된 모습
• 3분기 실적: 11월 17일(미국 시간, 한국시간 18일 오전)
🔗 https://t.co/QNoQ10CjgW
🔗 https://t.co/IzJ96snebZ
🔗 https://t.co/OB7xtDB87a

■ 3) 메타, 경량 모델 Muse Ember 공개 [회사 발표]
• 도구 호출, 코딩 하위 작업, 문서 추출처럼 에이전트가 반복하는 일을 맡기는 용도
• 가격: 입력 100만 토큰당 0.10달러, 출력 0.50달러. 입력이 20만 토큰을 넘으면 0.30달러·1.50달러
• 컨텍스트 창 100만 토큰. 텍스트·이미지·음성·영상을 모두 받음
• Artificial Analysis 지수에서 Claude Haiku 5.5와 같은 36점을 비용 약 3분의 1로 냈다고 밝힘. 회사 측 평가
🔗 https://t.co/qa17goROTX
🔗 https://t.co/B2NljOFxtv

■ 4) 구글, TPU 8tx·8i Max 추가 [회사 발표]
• 4월의 TPU 8t·8i에 더해 한 해에 TPU 시스템 4종을 내놓은 것은 처음
• 8tx: 8t와 같은 칩에 AMD 5세대 EPYC를 붙여 처리 중 데이터·가중치까지 하드웨어 수준에서 보호. 규제 산업·정부 고객 겨냥
• 8i Max: 8i 칩 2개를 한 패키지에 묶어 연산·SRAM·HBM 대역폭을 각각 2배로 늘림
• 구글은 TPU 고객이 100곳 가까이 된다고 밝힘
🔗 https://t.co/uVyAxO4HZa

■ 5) 딥시크 에이전트 앱 Harness, 일간 이용자 154만 명 [블룸버그·이차이]
• 11월 4일까지 한 주, 공식 API 기준. 8월 13일 출시 뒤 3개월이 채 안 됨
• 9월 말 약 27만 1,000명에서 늘어남. 하루 토큰 약 92조 개, 이용자 1인당 약 6,000만 토큰꼴
• 외부 플러그인 약 3만 5,000개. 에이전트가 채팅보다 연산을 훨씬 많이 쓴다는 점을 보여 주는 수치
🔗 https://t.co/Wct0LznFeM
🔗 https://t.co/7HayjhZ6YP

■ 6) 디즈니·어도비, 다년 AI 제휴 [회사 발표]
• 어도비 Firefly Foundry로 디즈니 캐릭터·배경·화풍을 학습한 전용 생성 모델을 함께 만듦
• 월트디즈니 이매지니어링은 이미 손 스케치를 콘셉트 아트로 바꾸는 모델을 사용 중
• 테마파크·크루즈, 스튜디오 시제작, ESPN 아카이브로 범위를 넓힘. 계약 금액은 비공개
🔗 https://t.co/ddENXU8tSO
🔗 https://t.co/zM3Qw5WssW

■ 7) 트럼프 "가드레일은 괜찮다" [CBS 「60 Minutes」·로이터]
• AI 위험은 관리할 수 있다며 "가드레일은 괜찮다"고 발언. 다만 규제 때문에 중국에 크게 뒤처져서는 안 된다고 함
• 민주당과 AI 안전 협력 가능하냐는 질문에는 "물론"이라고 답함
• 구체적인 법안이나 규칙은 내놓지 않음. 로이터는 기존 입장에서 달라진 신호로 해석
🔗 https://t.co/q3uRYOsgrf
🔗 https://t.co/F5Z3gGOqzZ

■ 오늘의 흐름
모델 경쟁은 가격으로 옮겨 감. 앤트로픽은 최상위 모델 값을 20% 내렸고, 메타는 0.10달러짜리 소형 모델로 반복 작업 시장을 노림. 딥시크 Harness의 하루 92조 토큰은 에이전트가 늘수록 연산 수요가 얼마나 커지는지 보여 줬고, 구글은 그 수요를 겨냥해 TPU 라인업을 넓힘. 엔비디아는 젠슨 황 리스크로 빠졌지만 AMD·브로드컴은 올라, 시장이 이번 일을 업종 전체가 아닌 엔비디아 경영 리스크로 보는 모습.

■ 체크리스트
□ Claude Fable 5.2 시스템 카드와 외부 평가(영국 AISI·METR) 요약
□ 엔비디아 이사회 조사·FBI 관련 추가 보도와 집단소송 진행
□ 11월 17일(미국 시간) 엔비디아 3분기 실적과 가이던스
□ Muse Ember 외부 벤치마크 재현 결과
□ 구글 TPU 8tx·8i Max 출시 시기와 가격 공개 여부

※ 공개된 기업 발표와 언론 보도를 정리한 정보 제공용이며 특정 종목의 매수·매도 권유가 아님. 벤치마크 수치는 각 회사 자체 평가 기준이고 실제 성능과 다를 수 있음. 트럼프 대통령의 FBI 관련 발언은 로이터 보도 기준. 내용은 2026년 11월 10일 오전(한국시간) 기준이며, 투자 판단과 그 결과는 투자자 본인에게 있음.

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Google AI policy forces decision for San Diego schools – NBC 7 San Diego
items.summary:
As districts consider their options, students are already seeing artificial intelligence become a more common part of everyday learning.

“I feel like I see a lot of people using AI now,” said Delilah Ortiz, a student at El Camino High School.

Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. However, districts that want to continue using Google Search will have to opt in to the AI features.

items.title: Jensen Huang is living proof that AI’s rockstar CEOs are also a hidden risk | CNN Business
items.summary:
Huang has also served as the AI industry’s ambassador on the international stage. He recently met with leaders in European capitals, pitching them on the idea of sovereign AI, where every country needs to build and control its own AI systems.

And Huang has presided over Nvidia’s effort to build out the AI ecosystem. In September, the company disclosed a staggering $99 billion worth of equity investments in this space, up from $2.2 billion two years ago. [...] President Donald Trump, left, and Open AI president Greg Brockman, right, listen as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks at the White House in Washington, DC, on September 29, 2026, after meeting with top executives of AI firms.

When worries about cheaper open models from China sparked selling in global markets, Huang teamed up with Wall Street power players to cobble together a $500 billion plan aimed at keeping the flow of money pumping into AI-powering chips. [...] While Nvidia’s most recent annual financial report to regulators does not directly spell out how much the company’s fate is linked to Huang, the filing does note the company is “highly dependent” on the services of its executive team. It also acknowledges that “failure to ensure effective succession planning” could “hinder our strategic planning, execution and long-term success.”

## AI’s everything man

items.title: Dems point to CISA staffing, AI security and other cyber priorities - Federal News Network

“That was glaringly obvious during the Salt Typhoon, Colonial Pipeline, and Change Healthcare hacks that affected millions of Americans, and it is an even more urgent problem today as AI tools will accelerate the speed and scale with which bad actors can disrupt our lives and our national security,” Warner said in a statement. “That is why cyber will remain a priority for me as we enter the new Congress and it is why I believe it is critically important we provide our government and the private [...] “I wouldn’t chalk that up solely to the outcome of the election,” Ugoretz told Federal News Network. “There is that, plus just the nature of the world that we’re living in now with some of long-standing challenges with cybersecurity that we faced over the years being accelerated and exacerbated by some of the new AI capabilities, but with a lot of promise too in terms of how AI can help be part of the solution.” [...] “Finally, we will make sure CISA is well-positioned to support the secure development and deployment of AI,” Thompson said.

Tonya Ugoretz, a cybersecurity leader at consulting firm PwC and former senior cyber official at the FBI, said cybersecurity is “demanding attention in a way that it hasn’t previously because of the impacts of AI.”

this is f*cking insane. andrej karpathy: "the biggest regret of every engineer in my field right now is every AI conversation they never saved, and in 10 years the ones who started saving in 2024 will be running circles around the rest of us"

andrej karpathy, co-founder of openai, pulled 16M views on one idea: stop using AI to write code, use it to build a second brain that remembers every article, pdf, transcript and conversation you ever fed it

you point claude code at a folder, drop anything into it, and claude reads it, cross-links it with everything already there, and writes it into a living wiki. your knowledge finally compounds instead of leaking out of your head every friday

the stack:

→ brew install obsidian, mkdir ~/vault, cd ~/vault
→ run claude in that folder and type "init a knowledge vault with CLAUDE.md as the rules, /raw for sources, /wiki for your pages"
→ drop any file into /raw (youtube transcript, meeting notes, 400-page pdf, screenshot of a tweet) and type "ingest"
→ claude writes a wiki page, links it to 5 existing ones automatically, updates CLAUDE.md with any new pattern it noticed about how you think
→ never open a blank claude chat again. every question goes through the vault, every answer cites your own sources with dates and links

5 minutes to set up. compounding knowledge from that evening forward

the ugly part most will scroll past: in 10 years the engineers who started this in 2024 will remember every book, every podcast, every meeting with receipts. you will remember none of them. karpathy already picked which side he is on and you are still not on his

items.title: スマートフォンの操作もAI Agentにやらせたいな～
items.summary:
スマートフォンの操作もAI Agentにやらせたいな～
OpenAIとかOpenCodeGoのAPIでスマートフォン操作させられないかな～～～！
裏で動いてくれて、自分の操作と両立出来るといいなぁ

と思って過ごしてたらMikaというOSSを@rS_alonewolfさんのポストで知ったので

中国向けだった仕様を日本向けに改変したMika JPというForkを作成しました！
Computer Useみたいなことがスマホで出来ます。
動画見てもらうとわかりますけど、裏で動いてくれるのでAI Agentに作業させながらX廃人も可能。

■本家との変更点
・変に情報の取ってないかの監査（無かった）
・画面、案内、エラーの表示言語と既定リソースを日本語に固定。
・日本語と英数字のOCRモデルをAPKに同梱。
・参照するWebサイトや、アプリを日本向けに変更
・その他全般の日本仕様へのチューニング。

もともと自分が使いたいなーっていう思いで、リスクと仕様を管理するためにフォークしたものですが、

開発者オプションをONにしたり、USBデバックをONにしたり、リスクを自分で管理したり、とかなり上級者向けのアプリですが、GitHub URLをAI Agentに投げてもらえればステップバイステップで導入ができるとは思います。

ライセンスは本家を継承し、Apache 2.0です。
本家の更新に合わせて。変なものが入らないか、自分が使いやすいようにという範囲で管理していく予定です。
Android限定かつ、Android 14以降じゃ無いと進化は発揮しない上級者向けAPPです。
